# Aryan™ Press

> Developer portfolio of Aryan, a 17-year-old in India building native apps and small web tools. Twelve projects, all free, no accounts.

## Projects
- [Archivum](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/archivum): A free digital library of thousands of books — Project Gutenberg + Internet Archive, displayed beautifully.
- [CamDroid](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/camdroid): Turn your Android device into a high-performance, ultra-low-latency virtual webcam & microphone for Linux.
- [Chess0](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/chess0): A chess engine written 100% from scratch in TypeScript — playing in your browser at over a million nodes per second.
- [Cloudy](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/cloudy): Connect the free 15GB+ you get with each Google account into one place.
- [CodePulse](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/codepulse): An X-ray for your codebase — complexity, churn risk & health metrics as a self-contained HTML report.
- [Digital Brain](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/digital-brain): A digital brain that fetches data from your conversations and processes it locally to build connections and improve context.
- [Galleria](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/galleria): An attempt at a good native Linux gallery app — beautiful UI, advanced editing, zero bloat.
- [Info9](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/info9): A zero-key, free & open-source intelligence workbench. Five specialist modules, no paid API keys, no accounts.
- [Music0](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/music0): Online music streaming for Musico — InnerTube search + yt-dlp playback, on every platform you own.
- [Musico](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/musico): My own music player for Linux — because every player I tried got in the way of the music.
- [SmollNet](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/smollnet): NetSentry — a real-time, Dockerized network traffic & anomaly sniffer with a cyberpunk live dashboard.
- [U&I](https://humon.is-a.dev/projects/uni): A private, exactly-two-people app for couples — the couple app that can't betray its users.
